reports.title: Census of Population
reports.description: The complete enumeration of Canada's population, required every five years by the Statistics Act. Supplies the population counts that provincial and municipal funding formulas ultimately rest on.
reports.cadence_note: Quinquennial — every five years. The coarse enum has no bucket for this; releases_per_year carries the truth. Collection for the 2026 Census began 4 May 2026; population counts release 10 February 2027.

release_schedule.note: The 2026 Census dissemination schedule, published as a key content release poster. Note the shape this exposes: releases_per_year is 0.2 because the census is quinquennial, yet seven releases land inside 2027. The rate describes the census; the schedule describes its dissemination, and they are different facts. Population and dwelling counts come first, which is the release most of this graph's downstream transfer formulas wait on.

reports.title: Funding Manual for School Authorities
reports.description: Annual rulebook setting every grant rate and formula by which Alberta's school authorities are funded. Defines the enrolment methodology that base instruction funding is calculated from.
reports.cadence_note: Published per school year, with in-year updates.

reports.title: Student Enrolment by School, Authority and Grade Level
reports.description: Annual enrolment counts reported to Alberta Education by public, separate, francophone, charter and private school authorities. Preliminary data is replaced by final data when available.

entries.covers: Preliminary 2026-27 school year enrolment data (based on the December 2026 student count)

release_schedule.note: Alberta Education's own open-data metadata (via the open.canada.ca federated CKAN record, package id ccbcf0fb-615e-44a0-b7ec-681e2ea4e1e7) tags maintenance_and_update_frequency as "not_planned" -- there is no published calendar or stated rule. However, the dataset has carried one resource pair (by-school and by-authority) per school year continuously from 2016/17 through 2025/26, confirming an annual cadence consistent with the corpus's releases_per_year=1. The most recent update (metadata_modified 2026-04-17) added the '2025/2026 student enrolment ... [Preliminary]' resources, and the companion page alberta.ca/student-population-statistics (meta-published 2026-06-18) states this preliminary data is 'Enrolment as of December 2025 student count.' By analogy, the 2026-27 school year's preliminary data (based on a December 2026 count) would be expected on the open data portal on a similar ~3-4 month lag, i.e. roughly Q1-Q2 2027 -- but since the publisher explicitly marks the frequency as not planned, this projected window is a low-confidence inference from a single observed cycle, not a guaranteed date.

dependencies.basis: The Municipal Affairs Population List is based on municipal census results or federal census data, and federal census counts are used where a municipality has not run its own census.
Alberta's municipal population estimation model is built on a standard methodology drawing on provincial administrative data together with federal government sources, specifically the federal census.

LFS population control totals start as a base estimate derived from the census, then updated monthly for births, deaths and migration. Every five years the entire series back to the previous census is re-weighted on the new counts.

Base instruction grants are allocated from an averaged enrolment figure for each school authority — a three-year Weighted Moving Average up to 2024/25, replaced by the Adjusted Enrolment Method from 2025/26.
